statements.t: Stivala said, “Fiscal 2026 was another strong year for Suburban Propane with solid results in our propane operations, the completion of capital projects to increase the scale of our renewable natural gas (“RNG”) business, and continued debt reduction to further strengthen our financial position.
We monetized approximately $3.0 million of the PTCs during fiscal 2026 and expect to monetize the remaining PTCs and the ITCs during fiscal 2027.
